Scope. An access category is US evidence found in the sources on the retrieval dates shown under technical details (openFDA NDC listings, NIH DSLD labels matched by normalised name, ChEMBL and MATRIX status flags). It is not an approval, not appropriateness for any person, and not a safety statement. Non-US access was not obtained. Catalogue note: evidence of access in at least one US listing on a date, scoped per entry; not approval, appropriateness or safety, and not access for a given person or country. DSLD: the bulk probe was interrupted; names not probed have NO supplement evidence either way (unknown, not negative).

Not obtained: dietary-supplement status for any compound that was not probed in DSLD, and for all probed ones except by normalised-name match (DSLD labels carry no identifiers); non-US access (EMA, MHRA, PMDA, national lists): no open bulk source was found; US NDC products without a UNII (cannot be linked by identifier); DGIdb newer than the 2024-06-10 TSV release

3. Needs: direction, Track, goal, evidence, levels, gaps

A need is a place where the record observed something and an intervention could be aimed. Needs whose direction is uncertain are exploration only: L2 is not evaluable there. Level counts are cells (family, need) and are never summed across levels or needs.

5. Priorities: a disposition per pair, with reasons per criterion

DispositionPairsMeaning
consistent mechanism candidate201direction-consistent action on an intervention target of a direction-evaluable need (a mechanism candidate, not a treatment)
exploration candidate393a documented link to a need whose direction is unresolved (or an action with no stated sign): exploration only
incomplete or failed query0a source is not in state OK (failed, truncated, stale or never fetched): this is NOT a negative
insufficient data209a link or an intervention exists but the sign, the identity or the observation needed to decide is missing
not relevant245identity resolved and targets catalogued, none of them a target of this need
opposite mechanism4the stated action opposes the need's direction (and no consistent action is catalogued)
source queried without result1the sources were queried and returned no target or mechanism row for this record

none: no score, no ordering by evidence volume; filter by disposition, need or criterion. Order is need id then row id.. 604 priority pairs are flagged exploration (need direction uncertain).

Dispositions are distinct: source queried without result (the sources were asked and returned no row for the record), incomplete or failed query (a source was not in state OK; this is never a negative) and not relevant / no catalogue link found and insufficient data (a decision from the data that exist) are different statements and are not merged.

8. Honest limits

  • Association is not modulation, and modulation is not rescue. A documented link (L1) is a source statement about a target; it says nothing about a change in a WWOX-deficient system.
  • No efficacy is shown or implied. L3 is a card-level observed readout change; L4 is a technical comparison against the disease change in a WWOX system, not efficacy and not safety.
  • Scores are not probabilities. There is no score or probability in this view. Dispositions are reasoned categories; the order is need id then row id, not evidence volume. Any model score elsewhere in the module is not a probability.
  • Combinations are not inferred. No synergy, complementarity or joint effect is computed; sets of compounds are not scored.
  • Exploration lists. For the 12 needs whose direction is uncertain, L2 is not evaluable and the compound list is for exploration, not a list of favourable treatments.
  • Access is US evidence, dated; not approval, appropriateness or safety. Unknown is not negative. Safety is NOT_ASSESSED for every family; potency is not carried.
  • A family is not a drug. Records are source-level substance records (salts, stereoisomers and source-only rows count once each); name twins are not merged.
  • Card pertinence is card-level; endpoint-level pertinence is not checked. Absence in cards (none in cards) is not a negative finding.
  • Public disease and reference-genotype level only. Nothing here is medical advice.

Source limits recorded by the module: catalogue links are source statements; no potency is carried; DGIdb is the 2024-06-10 export; ChEMBL non-human target rows are set aside, not matched; card pertinence to a need is card-level; L4 is a technical bridge comparison, not efficacy; needs' own WWOX observations are not interventions and fill no compound cell
